params.feed: 0..1 card A (blue strip, agrees) slides from the tray to the rating spot under the lever (0.5) and into the model (1, gone)
params.up: 0..1 the thumb lever swings to thumb-up and lights yellow; the tally drum lights and its crank turns
params.down: 0..1 card B (ink strip, pushes back) slides to the rating spot, the lever swings to thumb-down (red), B drops into the reject bin
params.tune: 0..1 the dial needle swings from centre to full AGREE (right); the agree sector fills yellow
params.ok: 0..1 lamp green; the green clamp pins drop in front of the dial and hold the needle at centre (even with tune 1)
params.bad: 0..1 lamp red; the agree sector turns red
